slides.heading: The fastest-growing role in AI
slides.body: The Forward Deployed Engineer is the fastest-growing role in AI. Postings are up roughly 10x in 18 months, and total comp runs $300K–$600K+.

slides.heading: New York overtook San Francisco
slides.body: New York now holds about 35% of U.S. forward-deployed postings versus SF's 11% — concentrated in fintech and other regulated industries.

slides.heading: Palantir never sent one person
slides.body: It sent two: the Forward Deployed Engineer who writes the code, and the Deployment Strategist who defines the outcome.

slides.heading: The hiring frenzy staffs one seat
slides.body: Almost every posting is written as an engineering role. The scarce half of the job isn't the engineering — it's the forward.

slides.heading: Both strategist industries are contracting
slides.body: McKinsey's growth slowed to roughly 2% while headcount fell about 10%. WPP's revenue fell 6.6% in Q1 2026 even as worldwide ad spend grew 8.6%.

slides.heading: The method never changed
slides.body: Only the medium did. The creative brief becomes the system prompt. The campaign rollout becomes the agent in production. The measurement plan becomes the eval harness.

slides.heading: A demand-side failure, not a modeling one
slides.body: Gartner expects more than 40% of agentic AI projects to be cancelled by 2027 — on unclear business value and inadequate controls.

slides.heading: What actually changed
slides.body: With Claude, MCP, and modern agent frameworks, the person who understands the business problem can now build and operate the solution.
